title: Adam and Eve
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child says God made Adam from dust and Eve from Adam's rib, gave one command, and tells how they disobeyed (Genesis 2:7, 21-22, 16-17; 3:6).

floor.prerequisite: Knows God created the sky and everything.
floor.question: Who created the sun, moon and stars?

board.do: Write: dust, breath, rib, one tree.

board.say: What did God say about this tree?

board.do: Wait for the child to say do not eat from it.
Order the story cards on the board.

misconceptions.ask: What does Genesis say about the fruit Adam and Eve ate?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 2:17 and 3:6. The tree is named, not the kind of fruit.
Act out Genesis 3:6 in order with two children.

misconceptions.ask: What did God use to make Eve?

listen_for: None, they could eat from all
misconceptions.ask: Which tree did God tell Adam not to eat from?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 2:16-17: every tree except one.

checks.question: What did God use to form Adam?

skills.key_step: The child states results of Adam's disobedience: shame and hiding, hard work for food, pain, death, sent out of Eden (Genesis 3:16-23).

floor.prerequisite: Knows how Adam and Eve disobeyed.
floor.question: Which tree did God tell them not to eat from?
floor.answer: The tree of the knowledge of good and evil

representations: a picture of the garden gate
contexts: a child who breaks a rule and feels ashamed
leaving home after doing wrong in a story

board.do: Wait for the child to name a result.

misconceptions.ask: What happened to Adam and Eve after they disobeyed?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 3:23. God still cared (he made them clothes), but there were results.

misconceptions.ask: After the disobedience, how would man get food?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 3:17-19 and act out hard digging.

listen_for: They were playing hide and seek
misconceptions.ask: Why did Adam and Eve hide from God?
misconceptions.repair: Ask how a child feels after breaking a rule. Link with Genesis 3:8-10.

listen_for: Still in the Garden of Eden
misconceptions.ask: Where did Adam and Eve live after they disobeyed?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the garden with a gate and Adam and Eve outside (Genesis 3:23-24).

checks.question: Name a result of Adam's disobedience.
checks.answer: They were sent out of the Garden of Eden (hard work, death)
